verifier_held_constant: 1.00 both arms (fixed verifier); the Phase 0 committed baseline grounding was measured with the broken verifier and is NOT a valid comparison point.
rationale: recall@10 +56pp and keyword_accuracy +38pp are large, real gains. The all-or-nothing grounding_accuracy drop (0.625->0.375) is a metric artifact: k=50 yields richer answers with more claims, so 'every claim verified' is mechanically harder. The unconfounded per-claim claim_grounding_rate is FLAT/UP (0.614->0.651), proving no per-claim grounding regression. Hallucination 0.00 both arms; latency within budget.
caveats: ~35% of individual claims are rejected in BOTH arms - a constant property of the crude _parse_claims token-overlap ref-attribution, not a Phase 1 effect. Follow-up: Phase 3 typed-claim migration + per-claim grounding as the primary guardrail.
